name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-taskqueue
description: Client-level task queue: dump non-urgent ideas, auto-execute during off-peak (cheap) windows or at set times; v0.4.0 adds /queue RPC channel (list/edit/cancel/runnow) for the editable queue panel in dsh-notice-banner; v0.5.0 adds queued-sending state (dispatched but still waiting in target session inbox) that remains cancelable — cancel withdraws the queued message via Inbox.remove (local helper plugin, not an official package)
